description: This file contains functions for generating a custom cash flow report in ERPNext, including setup for mappers, data aggregation, and report execution.

methods.name: get_mapper_for(mappers, position)
methods.description: Retrieve a mapper with a specific position from a list of mappers.

methods.name: get_mappers_from_db()
methods.description: Fetch all Cash Flow Mappers from the database.

methods.name: get_accounts_in_mappers(mapping_names)
methods.description: Get account details associated with specified mappers.

methods.name: setup_mappers(mappers)
methods.description: Initialize and organize mappers and their associated accounts.

methods.name: add_data_for_operating_activities( filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, mapper, data)
methods.description: Add operating activity data to the report.

methods.name: calculate_adjustment(filters, non_expense_mapper, expense_mapper, use_accumulated_values, period_list)
methods.description: Calculate tax and finance cost adjustments.

methods.name: _calculate_adjustment(non_expense_closing, non_expense_opening, expense_data)
methods.description: Compute adjustment values between opening and closing balances.

methods.name: add_data_for_other_activities( filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, mapper_list, data)
methods.description: Add other activity data to the report.

methods.name: compute_data(filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, full_mapper)
methods.description: Main function to assemble cash flow report data.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the custom cash flow report based on filters.

methods.name: _get_account_type_based_data(filters, account_names, period_list, accumulated_values, opening_balances=0)
methods.description: Retrieve account balances based on account types over periods.

methods.name: _add_total_row_account(out, data, label, period_list, currency, indent=0.0)
methods.description: Add total summary row to report data.

ctags.name: add_data_for_operating_activities
ctags.signature: ( filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, mapper, data)

ctags.name: add_data_for_other_activities
ctags.signature: ( filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, mapper_list, data)

ctags.name: compute_data
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_data(filters, company_currency, profit_data, period_list, light_mappers, full_mapper/
